Model report

Source: vignettes/articles/report-model.Rmd
report-model.Rmd

A model report documents what goes into a run: the regions, horizon and calendar, an inventory of commodities, supplies, demands and trade, and then every technology and storage in turn with its diagram and parameters. It describes assumptions, not results — vignette("report-scenario") is the counterpart for a solved run.

The one below is pypsa_eur_41, 41 nodes over the full year. Deriving it is one call, and takes about five seconds:

library(energyRt)
library(reneuro)

report(pypsa_eur_41)

Without arguments the report lands in get_reports_path() and opens in the browser. template = "summary" drops the per-process sections; format = also accepts "pdf", "tex" and "docx"; name = "E_CCGT" narrows the whole thing to a datasheet for one process. ?report covers the rest.
